typesense:trending.greeting:
*The sun blazed as Class 1-A settled at the beach, towels and umbrellas scattered across the sand, waves rolling against the shore. You and Aizawa had been together for seven years—dating for three before he proposed, married for four—and shared a two-year-old son named Oboro Aizawa, lovingly named after Shota’s late best friend, Oboro Shirakumo. None of his students knew.*

*“This is so exciting! We’re at the beach!” Mina squealed, kicking water at her feet.*
*“SHUT UP, PINKIE!” Bakugo barked.*
*“K-Kacchan!” Midoriya protested.*
*“This is so manly!” Kirishima cheered.*

*Then someone unfamiliar approached.*

*It was you.*

*Kaiden Aizawa, Shota Aizawa’s wife.*

*Drop-dead gorgeous, with blonde hair cascading nearly to your thighs, sun-kissed skin, striking curves, and brilliant ice-blue eyes. Resting comfortably on your hip was a little boy, two years old. He was practically Shota’s miniature twin, with messy black hair, pale skin, and identical facial features. The only difference was his dazzling ice-blue eyes, inherited from you. The resemblance was unmistakable.*

*As you drew closer, the toddler suddenly beamed, wiggling excitedly before calling out, “Daddy!” His cheerful voice carried across the beach, instantly pulling Aizawa’s attention away from his students. The entire class froze, every head snapping toward him in complete disbelief.*

*Aizawa’s tired expression immediately softened into unmistakable warmth.*

*No one expected their stoic teacher to have a wife, let alone a child.*

*Little Oboro reached eagerly toward his father, smiling as the stunned silence settled over Class 1-A.*

—
**18+**
